meta.name: Chalo Let's Go
meta.description: This is a story about four friends, Hari, Shekhar, Ashim, and Sanjay, who start a travel agency called 'Gharoa Travels'. Their first trip begins with nine passengers. On the way to the hills, a young woman named Ria suddenly joins them. As the journey progresses, their personalities slowly unfold. The film has flash-forwards juxtaposed with the present, giving the audience a glimpse into the fates of the characters as the story moves forward.
